source: OAuthApplications|The application could not be revoked because the authentication service did not respond. Nothing was changed. Try again in a few minutes.

source: OAuthApplications|The application could not be revoked. Nothing was changed, try again.
translation: Applikationen kunde inte återkallas. Inget ändrades, försök igen.

source: OAuthApplications|The application's access was revoked, but the list could not be updated. Click Revoke again.
translation: Applikationens åtkomst återkallades, men listan kunde inte uppdateras. Klicka på Återkalla igen.

source: OAuthApplications|The authentication service did not respond in time, so the application may not have been revoked. Try again.
translation: Autentiseringstjänsten svarade inte i tid, så applikationen kanske inte återkallades. Försök igen.
